name: Streets Of Miami DEMO
summary:
Streets of Miami VR is a gritty 1980s crime-action VR game set in a semi-open world version of Miami.



Start with nothing, learn the streets, make money, buy weapons, get vehicles, and work toward owning property before the city chews you up. The demo gives players a focused slice of the full game, introducing the core mechanics before releasing them into the streets with limited time to explore, hustle, and survive.



After the tutorial, you will have 13 minutes in the semi-open world demo area to make
